outcome: A secret-typed field holding `None` serializes as null instead of raising

acceptance_criteria.text: Serializing a model whose optional secret field is `None` produces null rather than an error.

expected_verification.assertion: dumping a model with an Optional[SecretStr] field set to None succeeds and yields None

acceptance_criteria.text: A secret field holding an actual value still serializes to its masked form, so nothing about the redaction changes.

expected_verification.assertion: dumping a populated secret field still yields the masked representation, not the plaintext
